Safeguard for MockitoListener API

- Added a safeguard that reminds users to clean up MockitoListeners via removeListener() method. The implementation is very simple, checking if the type of the listener is already added. I found out about this problem when working on strict stubbing support without JUnit runner.
- This change makes MockitoListener API safer. It's easy to leak state which we have encountered in our own test suite.
- If we encounter legit use cases for adding the same listener type, we can remove the safeguard or updated it
Added util class for asserting exceptions
